principles: Never reduce combat, movement, targeting, damage, cooldown, projectile, or AI simulation frequency.
Degrade cosmetics and diagnostics before simulation.
Use cached snapshots/spatial buckets instead of repeated full-display-list or full-army scans.
Pool high-churn transient objects and reuse arrays/vectors.
Batch UI invalidation and redraw on cadence rather than per-frame.
Apply spawn back-pressure only to sandbox/benchmark mass-spawn commands, never authored campaign waves.

low_level_targets.name: spatial_hash
low_level_targets.detail: Bucket living units by x/y cell once per simulation tick; melee/ranged acquisition queries neighboring cells before exact distance/hit tests.

low_level_targets.name: stable_active_vectors
low_level_targets.detail: Maintain active units/projectiles/buildings in typed vectors; no getChildAt battlefield scans inside hot combat loops.

low_level_targets.name: allocation_free_targeting
low_level_targets.detail: Reuse candidate vectors and avoid temporary arrays/Points/Rectangles in attack/AI loops.

low_level_targets.name: incremental_depth_order
low_level_targets.detail: Insert spawned actors at correct depth instead of sorting all battlefield children.

low_level_targets.name: projectile_pool
low_level_targets.detail: Pool arrows, bolts, particles and impact sprites; reset fields on checkout/return.

low_level_targets.name: effect_budget
low_level_targets.detail: Cull off-camera cosmetic effects and cap blood, dust, text, sparks and corpse fragments.

low_level_targets.name: ui_dirty_flags
low_level_targets.detail: Gold/mana/population/selection/tech panels redraw only when dirty and at configured max Hz.

low_level_targets.name: healthbar_stagger
low_level_targets.detail: Spread healthbar redraw across frames; HP simulation remains immediate.

low_level_targets.name: path_cache
low_level_targets.detail: Cache immutable path/node geometry and squared-distance helpers.

low_level_targets.name: ai_decision_cadence
low_level_targets.detail: Expensive strategic build/train choice runs at 4-8 Hz; unit tactical simulation remains full-rate.

low_level_targets.name: corpse_retirement
low_level_targets.detail: Detach dead bodies/effects after visible lifetime; never leave inactive clips in battlefield containers.

low_level_targets.name: benchmark_counters
low_level_targets.detail: Track FPS, frame time p50/p95/max, active units, projectiles, pooled objects, target checks and allocations where observable.

acceptance.simulation_rule: No reduced combat tick rate at any tier.
